title: backlog.py brief ID carries the 'Conduct for changes' section as text, so no worker spends a turn reading it or skips it
goal: brief ID prints the text of the 'Conduct for changes' section that selfdoc.py section maintaining prints, and its hint line says the section is already included

run:

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: of 219 worker sessions in 7 days (6,729 turns, 184 USD), 103 ran rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-worker (7.0 KB), 94 ran 'selfdoc.py section maintaining "Conduct for changes"' (5.6 KB), 57 both and 79 (36%) ran neither: the brief only hints at the first (bl_dispatch.py:375) and AGENTS.md demands the second before any change. All roles ran the conduct section 186 times in the week; the text is fixed. Saves about 200 worker turns (197 calls, about 12.6 KB read twice) and about 5 USD a week; the larger effect is rule compliance. The brief holds no 'Conduct for changes' text today (backlog.py brief ST-pueudigl | grep -c 'Conduct for changes' prints 0). Also wanted, not read by the planted check: the kb-worker rule-set lines (the tested rules rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-worker prints) are included the same way, and the role file agents/worker.md stops asking the worker to fetch them. The smallest of the set, zero judgment, high confidence. Lane: sprint orchestration, EP-gzr4mmkm.
